method: Isolated deterministic planning simulation. Same 100 fictional clients, 10 weekdays, durations, input release dates, rework cases and dependency gates as baseline. D reallocates C capacity; E adds 300 work minutes/day vs C (23.8%). Minutes are illustrative human-equivalent planning budgets, not observed agent speed. UI fixes alone do not increase capacity.
